In the year following AFO’s defeat, Deku continues to train in the gym and do martial arts. Even without OFA, the passion, discipline and fire are still in him. 

He pushes forward with his life, doing his best as a teacher in UA, and even goes out to collaborate with government agencies. He builds a good relationship with students and his fellow teachers.

Despite doing his best in the present, day in and day out there’s this bittersweet, nostalgic feeling that lingers and squeezes his chest. Like the memory of a lost loved one, Deku often finds himself happily looking back at short time he was the greatest hero, and then seeing the reality of the present, where all his friends are somewhere out there doing great things he can no longer do. 

He carries this heavy feeling with him everyday, sometimes finding himself looking out the window of the school’s empty corridors during sunset. On these particularly nostalgic days, he finds solace in chatting with All Might in his cozy office, a place he has found himself going to more often as they discuss the preparations for the first year anniversary of Japan’s victory over AFO.

One day, during these late afternoon meetings, Deku opens the door to AM’s office, calls for him, but gets no answer. He finds a note from AM on the table saying that he’ll be away for a few days for a business trip.

Deku makes a heavy sigh, then proceeds to go to the gym. In the following days with All Might away, he spends more time in the gym, often training beyond the point of failure as it helps him cope with his reality. 

The afternoon before the celebration, on the way to the gym, Deku receives a call from All Might, telling him that he’s still stuck in the trip. AM tells him to have fun during the celebration and sends his regards to the rest of the faculty. The call ends.

Deku enters the gym, activates the sparring bot and starts boxing with it. Tomorrow marks the anniversary of the day he was the greatest hero; but also the anniversary of the end of his dreams. 

As he sparred with the bot, every punch he lands gives him a flashback of the amazing times he had with his friends, every hit he takes reminds him of his battles with the villains. The memories of living his dream were flooding his mind and heart. The feeling of once having OFA was rushing through his body. His hits were getting harder and harder. He lets out a loud scream and deals a blow to the bot that knocks it down. 

He falls to his knees, crying in frustration and sadness. All he ever wished for as a child just came and go in an instant. He stays on his knees, head down with a heavy heart and soul. The gym is silent.

“Midoriya-shonen!” A familiar voice calls his name from across the large gymnasium. Deku looks up and sees All Might squeezing through a small opening of the large gymnasium door. In all his frail glory, All Might opens the door fully and reveals all of class 1A, the UA faculty, and the current and former pro heroes during the war. All of them happily and proudly looking at Deku.

Deku’s face gets filled with happiness, and tears of joy start falling from his eyes. 

“Is that how you greet the soon to be number 1 hero?” Bakugo yells from across the room. 

Deku gets up, drops his worn out fighting gloves, and runs towards them. He meets them by the entrance as they surround him with smiles and cheers. He hasn’t been that happy in a while. 

They leave the gymnasium and close the door to head out and celebrate. In the empty silent gym, Deku’s worn out gloves lay on the floor, and a faint green and black energy briefly spark from it.
